title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG'S NAME IS ONCE MORE AT A PREMIUM ON 'CHANGE
summary_hover: As the deadline for the wager approaches, Fogg's friends wait at the Reform Club until he dramatically appears at the final second.
summary_detail: Following the arrest of the real bank robber, James Strand, public opinion in London swings entirely back in Phileas Fogg's favor. On the evening the wager is set to expire, his five friends anxiously wait in the Reform Club while a massive crowd gathers outside. Having received no news, the men count down the final seconds of the wager, only for Fogg to suddenly enter the room right on time.
